**Install:** download `Serpentine-x.y.z.dmg` below, open it and drag Serpentine into Applications. For Apple
silicon Macs (M1 and later), macOS 12 or newer.

**First start:** this build has no Apple Developer ID, so it isn't notarized and macOS won't open it on a double
click the first time. Try once, then open System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security, scroll down to "Serpentine was
blocked" and click **Open Anyway**. After that it opens normally. Allow Bluetooth when asked: that's how it finds
the trainer.

**Updates:** this copy doesn't update itself. Help ▸ Check for Updates opens this page; install a newer DMG over the
old copy. Rides, profiles and settings stay in `~/Documents/Serpentine`.
